candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout; the gateway's own latency is low (p95 ~325ms, responses 16-110ms), so the failure originates in the order dependency.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show order 500s but not the internal cause (DB, payment, inventory); logs were excluded, so the specific order-side fault is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces consistently show POST /v1/orders returning 500, propagated as 502 on /v1/checkout, while gateway metrics show low latency and healthy 200s on other routes. The bounded candidate is an order-service HTTP 500 fault; the specific internal cause needs order-side evidence.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/stack traces for the 500 on /v1/orders to identify the internal failure (db-pool, payment, inventory)
Order-side dependency metrics (payment, postgresql, inventory) to rule out downstream causes
